comment: Post-activation smoke assertions (spec §3). Every packages[] entry in overlays/updates.json must appear here, with either a command+version_regex or a skip reason — enforced by scripts/check-overlay-manifest.sh. The version_regex must capture a version comparable to that package's current_version; matching the VERSION (not just exit 0) is what catches a silently-wrong binary.

assertions.skip: not installed into any systemPackages/home-manager profile on this host; only exported as the buildable flake package `nix build .#trailbase` via optionalAttrs in flake.nix, so there is no `trail` binary on PATH to smoke-test
overlay provides pkgs.igir but it is not wired into any systemPackages/home-manager list or flake `packages` output on this host, so there is no `igir` binary on PATH to smoke-test
